text:
maria: Heads up — AtlasCompute shipment for SA cluster (Santiago) is stuck at BUE customs. We were expecting 24 cards to land today, currently showing as 'under review'. Need vendor escalation & RMA follow-up, we’re at ~60% of requested capacity for the region. Can someone chase Atlas contact? :eyes:

raj: Do we have AWB + RMA info? Is this a DOA batch or customs/document hold?

maria: AWB + RMA in thread:```
AWB: AR123456789LU
RMA: ATLAS-RMA-84273
Items: 24x GFX-A100-80GB (serials partial list)
Serials: GFX-AX1-0001, GFX-AX1-0004, GFX-AX1-0010...
Issue: customs hold for valuation + missing KC number
```

atlas-bot: AtlasCompute update: RMA ATLAS-RMA-84273 created. Current status: "Customs documentation requested". Estimated warehouse arrival after clearance: 72h. Escalation contact: esteban@atlascompute.com.

ops-supply: Filed amendment with shipper (CourierLU). Submitted revised commercial invoice tagging as "replacement units" and added HS code 847130. Tracker shows hold reason: mismatch in declared value vs. invoice. Requesting customs release — may need finance sign-off for adjusted declaration. :thinking:

luis: If clearance drags >48h we need temporary capacity plan. How many usable cards did QA flag as DOA?

maria: QA found 3 DOA on initial unpack. Atlas agreed to partial replacement; they said they can RMA 3 spares out of upcoming pool but need approval for expedited air. Rest are fine.

jenny: Cost tradeoff: expedite air for 3 replacements ~ +$7k, or temp burst on cloud SA region estimated $4k/day. If latency is critical, air-expedite. Ops, please quote total expedite cost vs cloud burst hours.

raj: Also confirm warranty paperwork — Atlas insisted replacements covered under RMA but customs may treat value as new goods -> duty. Finance please advise on import duty exposure.

ops-supply: Noted. I've opened ticket with Finance (FIN-3331) to confirm duty liability. Also requested Atlas provide pro forma marking: "Advance replacement under warranty — no commercial value". Waiting on vendor to accept wording.

atlas-bot: Vendor update: Atlas support (Esteban) confirmed they can issue a pro forma and attach repair/replace declaration within 6 hours if legal ok. They can also divert 6 loaner cards from EU pool to expedite to BUE (ETA 48h if air).

maria: If loaners available, that covers immediate needs. Please lock the 6 and start customs paperwork. Ops, ping me once courier has the revised invoice.

luis: I'll take the lock + staging action. Can someone drop the exact serial list Atlas needs for partial RMA processing?

maria: Sent serials in the code block above. I'll DM full sheet to luis and esteban.

raj: One more ask — log this as incident for capacity (INC-5421) so we can correlate cost delta and SLA impact.

ops-supply: INC-5421 created. I'll update with cost estimates and final customs clearance time when available.

maria: Thanks — will monitor. If Atlas doesn't provide pro forma in 6h escalate to regional ops lead and CSM. :pray:
